packages.title: Used-up dictations: a kept recording closes with one button; copy fixes
brief: Context: b7 round 1 ran P89, P90, P93 (area A). Reviewer A (verify-b7-r1-A.md) found UX-496 to UX-499 fixed in code, and three regressions from P90/P89. They are new, first attempt each. Free-tier rules (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-13 late): 10 free dictations a month, typing never capped. Don't change any of that.

UX-502 (R1A-1, S2, from P90). What P90 did: after a 402 `free_voice_used_up`, it sets `_typing = true` (voice_task_screen.dart:1146). For a capture that is only a recording with no words (`waitsForMore`, :1537), the sheet then shows the `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording` line ('Tu grabación se conserva. Se podrá entender a partir del…'), 'Ver Pro', an EMPTY typing field (key `capture-words`, hint 'Médico el viernes a las 17:00'), and only 'Cancelar'. The `refused` branch of `primary` (:1589-1599) adds no button, because 'Guardar tal cual' needs words. 'Cancelar' (`_controls`, :1841-1844) runs `_cancel` (:1316-1355), which opens the 'Conservar lo que has dicho?' dialog with a red 'Descartar', asking about a recording the sheet just said is kept. The same state appears when such a capture is reopened from Capturas pendientes at 0 left.

Fix UX-502 by subtracting. Define the state once, for example a getter `_recordingWaits` = the build's `waitsForMore` AND `_previousResult == null` (after 'Volver a decirlo', `_cancel` already goes back to the result with no dialog; leave that path alone). Move the `usedUp` / `refused` / `waitsForMore` computation into a helper if that's needed, so `build` and `_cancel` use the same rule.

In that state: (1) don't show the typing field. The words area shows nothing (`words` is null), even though `_typing` is true. (2) `primary` is exactly one `FilledButton` with the new key `captureClose`: EN `Close` / ES `Cerrar` / CA `Tanca`. It calls `Navigator.pop(context)` at once. The capture stays in the pending store, as the dialog's 'Conservar' does today. (3) Hide 'Cancelar' in that state: add a `showCancel` flag to `_controls` (default true), so the row is just 'Cerrar'. The keyboard icon is already hidden for recorded captures (`showType: !_typing && !recorded`, :1789). (4) In `_cancel`, for that state, pop at once with no dialog, so Back and a swipe down behave like 'Cerrar'. 'Ver Pro' (`voiceProAction`) and the used-up line stay as they are.

Don't touch: the words-kept case after a 402, where the typing field, 'Guardar tal cual' and 'Cancelar' with its keep question stay. Also leave `_discard`, the 503 `billing_unavailable` handling, and the listening/Pro path.

Existing test to update: capture_free_dictations_test.dart:543-549 taps 'Conservar' after 'Cancelar' in this state. It should now tap 'Cerrar' and expect no AlertDialog. Keep the rest of that test's assertions (the capture is still listed).

UX-503 (R1A-2, S1, from P90 and P92). In Catalan, `{date}` is `DateFormat.MMMd('ca')`, which gives '1 de nov.'. The reset is the 1st of the month, so the text reads 'el 1 de nov.' / 'a partir del 1 de nov.', where Catalan needs 'l’1' / 'de l’1'. Other days can read 'el 30', so a fixed elision is wrong. Catalan only: put 'dia' before the date. app_ca.arb:875 `freeVoiceUsedUp` → `Ja has fet servir els dictats gratuïts d’aquest mes. La pots escriure aquí; en tindràs més el dia {date}.` :876 `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording` → `La gravació es conserva. Es podrà entendre a partir del dia {date}, o ara amb Pro.` :877 `freeVoiceStatus` → keep the plural part exactly as it is and change only the end, from `Més el {date}.` to `Més el dia {date}.`. EN and ES stay as they are.

UX-504 (R1A-3, S1, from P89). `freeVoiceLeft` shows under a spoken result whenever 3 or fewer are left (voice_task_screen.dart:2371), including 0, where it reads 'Te quedan 0 dictados gratis este mes'. Add an `=0` branch to each plural and keep `=1` and `other` as they are: EN (app_en.arb:1690) `=0{No free dictations left this month}` / ES (app_es.arb:1180) `=0{Ya no te quedan dictados gratis este mes}` / CA (app_ca.arb:874) `=0{Ja no et queden dictats gratuïts aquest mes}`. Don't change when the line shows.

Add `captureClose` to all three ARB files, with an @-description: 'Closes the capture sheet when only a recording is kept and free dictations are used up'. Run `flutter gen-l10n`. Never edit lib/l10n/generated by hand.
acceptance: Widget test: a free account, Spanish, 2× text on 360×740. A recording-only capture (audio, no words) gets a 402 free_voice_used_up. The sheet shows 'Tu grabación se conserva. Se podrá entender a partir del 1 nov, o ahora con Pro.' and 'Ver Pro'. It has no `capture-words` field, no 'Cancelar', and exactly one FilledButton, 'Cerrar'.
Widget test: in that state, tapping 'Cerrar' closes the sheet with no AlertDialog. The capture is not discarded and is listed in Capturas pendientes.

Widget test: the same recording-only capture reopened from Capturas pendientes at 0 left shows the same single 'Cerrar' and no typing field. The system Back closes it with no AlertDialog, and the capture is still listed.
Widget test: a spoken capture with words that gets a 402 still shows the typing field with its words, 'Guardar tal cual' and 'Cancelar' (unchanged).

Unit test: in Catalan, with 1 November, `freeVoiceUsedUp` contains 'el dia 1 de nov.', `freeVoiceUsedUpRecording` contains 'a partir del dia 1 de nov.', and `freeVoiceStatus` ends with 'Més el dia 1 de nov.'. The ES and EN texts are unchanged.

Unit test: `freeVoiceLeft(0)` is 'No free dictations left this month' / 'Ya no te quedan dictados gratis este mes' / 'Ja no et queden dictats gratuïts aquest mes'. Counts 1 and 3 are unchanged in all three languages.
Widget test: `captureClose` reads 'Close' / 'Cerrar' / 'Tanca'. In Catalan at 2× text on 320 dp, the recording-only state shows 'Tanca' with no overflow.
deviceChecks: On a free account with 0 dictations left, open a kept recording from Capturas pendientes: one 'Cerrar' button and no keyboard opens. Tap it: the sheet closes with no question, and the recording is still in Capturas pendientes.

packages.title: File space: usage refreshes after uploads; the full message says where
brief: Context: b7 round 1 ran P91 (UX-500). Reviewer B (verify-b7-r1-B.md) found it fixed in code, with three follow-ups. They are new, first attempt each. Free accounts have 100 MB of file space (DECISIONS.md, 2026-10-13 late). No new screens or settings.

UX-505 (R1B-1, S2, from P91). The usage line (`_usage`, attachment_panel.dart:150-162) reads `account.storage`. That value is refreshed only on restore (auth_provider.dart:84), after a removal (attachment_panel.dart:139-142), and after a refusal of the user's own space (`rememberStorage`, attachment_store.dart:285). A successful upload (attachment_store.dart:260-280) refreshes nothing. So a free user at 75% who attaches photos sees no warning until the refusal.

Fix: in `AttachmentStore._sync`, count the uploads that succeed (the `_update(... 'upload_pending': 0 ...)` after the server confirms). After the loop, if at least one succeeded, refresh the account's storage once. Do this only when the saved account (`api.account`) has a `storage` block and is not `complimentaryPro`; the store can't see store-bought Pro, and one extra request after an upload is harmless. Recommended route, which stays inside services: a small `ApiClient.refreshStorage({required int accountId})` that does `GET auth/me/` for that account and passes the answer's `storage` to the existing `rememberStorage`. `_remember` already checks the account and generation and emits `accountUpdated`, and `AuthNotifier` already listens to it (auth_provider.dart:45-55), so the panel updates with no new provider. Swallow errors, as the removal path does. If you find a cleaner caller for the existing `authProvider.notifier.refreshAccount()`, that is acceptable if the outcome is the same.

This can't loop. The account update rebuilds the repository and runs one more sync (P91's implementer note 4). That sync uploads nothing, so it doesn't refresh again. Don't refresh after a sync with no successful upload.

UX-506 (R1B-2, S2, from P91). `storageFull` says 'Remove a file to make room', but it shows under the refused file (attachment_panel.dart:265), the other files sit on other tasks, and removing the refused file frees nothing. Reword it in all three ARB files, keeping `{limit}`: EN `Your file space is full ({limit} MB). Remove files from other tasks to make room, or get Pro for unlimited space.` / ES `Tu espacio para archivos está lleno ({limit} MB). Elimina archivos de otras tareas para hacer sitio o hazte Pro para tener espacio ilimitado.` / CA `El teu espai per a fitxers és ple ({limit} MB). Treu fitxers d’altres tasques per fer lloc o fes-te Pro per tenir espai il·limitat.` Don't add a list or a finder for tasks with files: that is an owner question (see the plan.md decisions).

UX-507 (R1B-3, S1, from P91). The usage line 'Files: …' / 'Archivos: …' sits under the heading 'Attachments' / 'Adjuntos': two names for one thing. Keep 'Files' (`storageUsage`, `storageFull` and the Pro screen already use it) and rename the heading key `attachments`: EN `Attachments` → `Files`, ES `Adjuntos` → `Archivos`. CA `Fitxers adjunts` stays. The key is used only by the two `SectionLabel`s (attachment_panel.dart:207 and widgets/task_editor.dart:758), so both headings change, which is intended. Don't rename the key itself, and don't change other strings that say 'attachment' (buttons, statuses), because they aren't next to the usage line.
Run `flutter gen-l10n`. Update existing tests that look for 'Attachments' / 'Adjuntos' or the old `storageFull` text.
acceptance: Unit or widget test: a free account saved at 78 of 100 MB, with a queued file. The upload succeeds and `auth/me/` answers `storage` 82 MB. The attachment panel then shows 'Files: 82 of 100 MB used' (EN) without reopening the task, and that sync made exactly one `auth/me/` request.
Unit test: a sync where nothing uploads (nothing queued, or the only file refused) makes no `auth/me/` request. The sync that follows the account update makes none either.

Widget test: Spanish, 2× text on 320 dp, a file refused for the user's own space. The row shows 'Tu espacio para archivos está lleno (100 MB). Elimina archivos de otras tareas para hacer sitio o hazte Pro para tener espacio ilimitado.' and 'Ver Pro', with no overflow. EN and CA show their new texts.

Widget test: Spanish, at 85 of 100 MB, the panel's heading reads 'Archivos' and the line under it 'Archivos: 85 de 100 MB usados'. In EN the heading reads 'Files'; in CA it still reads 'Fitxers adjunts'.
Widget test: the task editor's files section heading reads 'Archivos' in Spanish.
deviceChecks: On a free account at about 75 MB, attach photos until it passes 80%: the 'Archivos: … de 100 MB usados' line appears after the upload, without a restart.

packages.title: Account and Pro: sign-out shows progress; copy points to what exists
brief: Context: b7 round 1 ran P44 and P92 (area D). Reviewer D (verify-b7-r1-D.md) found UX-408, UX-423 and UX-501 fixed in code, with three regressions. They are new, first attempt each. No new copy except what is given here.

UX-508 (R1D-1, S2, from P44). P44 removed the spinner at the bottom of the Account list. Sync and Import got their own spinners in the button, but sign-out didn't. After the confirm dialog, `_running == _Action.signOut` only greys the button out, while `AuthNotifier.signOut` waits up to 12 s on `POST auth/logout/` (api_client.dart:451-455). Fix at account_screen.dart:280-289: make 'Cerrar sesión' a `TextButton.icon`. Its icon is the same `progress` widget Sync and Import use (the 18 dp indicator defined at :147) while `_running == _Action.signOut`, and nothing otherwise: no icon at rest, so the button looks as it does today. Keep the error colour on the label, and colour the indicator `colors.error` too. If `TextButton.icon` forces an icon, use a `TextButton` whose child is a Row with the indicator and the label. No new copy. Don't touch the confirm dialog, Sync, Import, or the Google-link path.

UX-509 (R1D-2, S2, from P44). P44 removed 'Actualizar estado', but three billing messages still tell people to refresh. Change only these select branches, in all three ARB files: `billingError.accountUnavailable`, `billingError.network`, and `billingResult.awaitingEntitlement` (app_en.arb:1530-1531, app_es.arb:1094-1095, app_ca.arb:788-789). Keep every other branch exactly as it is.

accountUnavailable: EN `Connect to the TaskFlow server to link your subscription.` / ES `Conéctate al servidor de TaskFlow para vincular tu suscripción.` / CA `Connecta’t al servidor de TaskFlow per vincular la subscripció.`

network: EN `Could not check your subscription. Check your connection and open this screen again.` / ES `No se pudo comprobar tu suscripción. Revisa tu conexión y vuelve a abrir esta pantalla.` / CA `No s’ha pogut comprovar la subscripció. Revisa la connexió i torna a obrir aquesta pantalla.`

awaitingEntitlement: EN `Purchase received. Pro will turn on in a few moments; if it doesn’t, tap Restore purchases.` / ES `Compra recibida. Pro se activará en unos momentos; si no, pulsa Restaurar compras.` / CA `Compra rebuda. Pro s’activarà d’aquí a uns moments; si no, toca Restaura les compres.` (These match `billingRestore` in each catalog.)

UX-510 (R1D-3, S2). P92's Pro-screen line says 'Archivos: 3 de 100 MB usados', but `fileUploadHelp` (shown in widgets/task_editor.dart:369 and :817) tells everyone, Pro included, '6 MiB each, 64 MiB per account'. That text predates the free tier; the contradiction is new with P92. Remove the per-account cap, and use MB as `storageUsage` does: EN (app_en.arb:920) `New files upload to your account after saving, up to 6 MB each. Older local files stay on this device until you choose Upload in task details.` / ES (app_es.arb:550) `Los archivos nuevos se suben a tu cuenta al guardar, hasta 6 MB cada uno. Los archivos locales anteriores permanecen aquí hasta que elijas Subir en los detalles de la tarea.` / CA (app_ca.arb:529) `Els fitxers nous es pugen al compte després de desar, fins a 6 MB cadascun. Els fitxers locals anteriors es queden al dispositiu fins que triïs Puja als detalls de la tasca.` (the organizer's Catalan: the existing sentence with the cap removed). Don't change task_editor.dart.
Run `flutter gen-l10n`. Update existing tests in subscription_screen_test.dart or account_regional_ui_test.dart that look for the old texts.
acceptance: Widget test: Account in Spanish, with a sign-out that never completes. After confirming 'Cerrar sesión', a progress indicator sits inside the 'Cerrar sesión' button. Before confirming, the button shows no indicator.
Grep: inside `billingError` and `billingResult` in app_en.arb, app_es.arb and app_ca.arb, there is no 'refresh', 'actualiza' or 'actualitza'.
Widget test: the Pro screen in Spanish with a network billing error shows 'No se pudo comprobar tu suscripción. Revisa tu conexión y vuelve a abrir esta pantalla.'
Unit test: `billingResult('awaitingEntitlement')` names the restore button in each language ('Restore purchases' / 'Restaurar compras' / 'Restaura les compres').
Grep: no 'MiB' and no '64' in `fileUploadHelp` in the three ARB files. The task editor in Spanish shows 'Los archivos nuevos se suben a tu cuenta al guardar, hasta 6 MB cada uno. …'
deviceChecks: Staging, with a slow or offline network: Account › Cerrar sesión › confirm, and the spinner shows in the button until the screen changes.

decisions.question: When the file space is full, should the app help people find which tasks hold files (for example a marker on task rows, or a list of files)?
decisions.recommendation: Not now. P95 rewords the message to say the files are on other tasks, which needs no new UI. Revisit if free users hit the cap in practice. It would add a concept, so it's the owner's call.
